A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TRINITY research work, with complete main text and Appendices A.1–A.7. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable matching of the figures, tables, equations, and appendix material.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, transfer results, ablations, and optimizer comparisons in Section 4, plus representation analyses and synthetic experiments in Appendix A.3.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical outcomes, including the benchmark and ablation tables in Section 4 and the representation and synthetic-data results in Appendix A.3.

M1.justification: The coordinator architecture, singular-value fine-tuning, agent and role selection, stopping procedure, and sep-CMA-ES training remain unchanged. The corrected Figure 2 reference points to head designs already documented in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions retain MATH500, MMLU, RLPR, and LiveCodeBench evaluation, transfer to AIME2025, BigCodeBench, MT-Bench, and GPQA-D, and the same synthetic representation experiments. No dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Figure 3 and Tables 4, 7, and 8: the same routing methods, individual-model variants, optimizer baselines, majority voting, and prompted LLM coordinator are evaluated.

E3.justification: The reported protocols are identical, including the default 4096-token limit, five-turn budget, and LiveCodeBench V1 training with 400 samples and V6 evaluation with 175 samples. Appendix baseline settings and analysis procedures are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations, head-architecture comparisons, turn-budget analysis, agent-selection analyses, and representation-separability experiments are retained without modification in Section 4 and Appendices A.2, A.3, and A.7.

E5.justification: Reported uncertainties, SFT label-generation seed information, and replication counts are unchanged. This includes the uncertainty entries in Table 7 and the repeated-trial descriptions in Appendices A.1, A.2, and A.5.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings match across versions. For example, both retain the 86.2% LiveCodeBench result and the 54.21 transfer average in Table 1; appendix baseline, separability, and token-usage results also remain identical.

T1.justification: Definition 1's bounds (B1)–(B3) in Appendix A.1 have small spacing changes but identical mathematical content. The definitions, assumptions, propositions, derivations, and proofs are otherwise unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about lightweight coordination, optimization efficiency, benchmark performance, and generalization.

C2.justification: The interpretations of separability, coordination behavior, optimizer performance, and SFT labeling costs are unchanged. Both versions retain the limitation that the system can plan tool use but cannot execute those actions.

D1.justification: Implementation specifications, hyperparameters, parameter counts, baseline instructions, and code/weights availability statements are unchanged. Repairing the Figure 2 link improves access to existing Appendix A.4 content without adding technical information.

R1.justification: Section 5, the reference list, and citations retain the same works and positioning relative to model merging, routing, and multi-agent coordination. No prior work or novelty relationship is added or revised.

P1.justification: Figure 2's unresolved 'Appendix ??' reference becomes 'Appendix A.4,' and the first-page arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The prose, terminology, and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2's caption gains the corrected, functioning appendix link, and bounds (B1)–(B3) receive small horizontal-spacing adjustments. No figures or tables are added, removed, redrawn, or relocated.

improvement.justification: v3 repairs Figure 2's broken appendix reference and links readers to the existing head-architecture description in Appendix A.4, providing a small improvement in editorial correctness and navigation. The equation-spacing adjustments preserve the mathematics; scientific evidence, claims, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
